array.string: public_key=$(/usr/bin/git config --file "$HOME/.config/git/platform.conf" --type=path --get user.signingkey) || exit 1 case "$public_key" in *.pub) signing_key=${public_key%.pub} ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac if [ ! -r "$signing_key" ]; then exit 1 fi if [ -z "$SSH_AUTH_SOCK" ]; then SSH_AUTH_SOCK=$(/bin/launchctl getenv SSH_AUTH_SOCK) export SSH_AUTH_SOCK fi exec /usr/bin/ssh-add -S /usr/lib/ssh-keychain.dylib "$signing_key"
